mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% signals an acceleration in manufacturing output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
